text:
Rita Lopez: Hi folks, newbie here. Running the Python quickstart; set REDWOOD_API_KEY and WORKSPACE_ID then ran `python quickstart.py`. The client returns a 403 with message 'billing_required' after about 8s. SDK also printed a bunch of `refresh token` logs. Anyone seen this on fresh accounts?

Rita Lopez: Excerpt from STDOUT: 
[2026-02-12T09:12:01.456Z] INFO redwood.client: sending request -> /v1/chat/completions
[2026-02-12T09:12:09.471Z] WARN redwood.auth: no refresh token found, attempting fallback (api_key)
[2026-02-12T09:12:09.471Z] WARN redwood.auth: fallback attempt 2
[2026-02-12T09:12:09.472Z] ERROR redwood.client: request failed status=403 error=billing_required workspace=wk_newb001
{"error":{"code":"billing_required","message":"Workspace wk_newb001 requires billing"}}

Theo Morgan: Hi @Rita — couple of quick troubleshooting steps: 1) try a raw curl to rule out SDK; 2) confirm the workspace in the admin console; 3) which SDK version?

Rita Lopez: SDK is @redwood/inference-python 1.0.0b2. Curl output: 
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}]}'

HTTP/2 403
content-type: application/json
x-request-id: rq_demo_123

{"error":{"code":"billing_required","message":"Billing required for workspace wk_newb001"}}

Nora Patel: Curl confirms it's server-side (billing gate). @devex-bot please surface billing state for wk_newb001.

devex-bot: Workspace wk_newb001 9 status: credits_exhausted; last_grant: 2025-11-20; payment_method: none; plan: free_trial

Luis Gomez: We rolled out a policy last quarter to shorten trial credit windows if suspicious activity detected. That said, SDK should not spam auth refresh when a static API key is used. Filing DX-1135: python sdk should short-circuit refresh with static api key and surface billing_required as a clearer error (include workspace id + next steps).

Rita Lopez: Thanks. I need a quick unblock to finish the tutorial. Options?

Theo Morgan: Short-term: 1) add a card to the workspace (fastest for users) 2) request Growth to top-up credits (can take a day) 3) we can issue a demo key tied to a demo workspace (expires in 12h). Which do you want?

Rita Lopez: Demo key please. No billing for my laptop :)

Luis Gomez: Created workspace wk_demo_456 and key sk_demo_456 (12h). DMing encrypted key now.

Rita Lopez: Demo key works, saw first successful chat response. Thanks everyone :party_popper:

Nora Patel: Action items: Theo will add a short "billing gate" troubleshooting section to the quickstart docs showing the curl test and common fixes; Luis owns DX-1135 to prevent auth refresh noise and improve error text. ETA docs PR by EOD; DX-1135 assigned with priority P2.

Rita Lopez: Closing thread. Appreciate the quick help!
